data.value: Use an IP (e.g. 8.8.8.8) or a name (e.g. dns.google).

data.name: Network_PingHint
data.value:
cobihw uses this address only for the ping test (like running ping 8.8.8.8 in PowerShell or Command Prompt).
8.8.8.8 -> Google (default). 1.1.1.1 -> Cloudflare, the same network used by the speed test. With ping measurement off, cobihw makes no other automatic network connection.

data.value: Uses Cloudflare servers. Uses about 200 MB on a 100 Mbps connection and 700 MB on a 1 Gbps one. The internet may be slow or unstable during the test, which takes 10 to 30 seconds depending on the connection.
